about: The freeform apply_patch tool as Codex rust-v0.158.0 sends it when the catalog's apply_patch_tool_type is freeform (core/src/tools/handlers/apply_patch_spec.rs, grammar core/assets/tools/apply_patch.lark, verbatim), and a patch for it.

freeform_tool.name: apply_patch
freeform_tool.description: The `apply_patch` tool can be used to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.

format.definition:
start: begin_patch hunk+ end_patch
begin_patch: "*** Begin Patch" LF
end_patch: "*** End Patch" LF?

hunk: add_hunk | delete_hunk | update_hunk
add_hunk: "*** Add File: " filename LF add_line+
delete_hunk: "*** Delete File: " filename LF
update_hunk: "*** Update File: " filename LF change_move? change?

filename: /(.+)/
add_line: "+" /(.*)/ LF -> line

change_move: "*** Move to: " filename LF
change: (change_context | change_line)+ eof_line?
change_context: ("@@" | "@@ " /(.+)/) LF
change_line: ("+" | "-" | " ") /(.*)/ LF
eof_line: "*** End of File" LF

%import common.LF

patch:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/app.py
@@ def greet():
-    print("Hi")
+    print("Hello \"world\"	and a tab")
*** Add File: notes.txt
+one
+two
*** End Patch
